## Kevin Durant Bio

**Kevin Wayne Durant** (born **September 29, 1988**, age 37), also known by his initials **KD**, is an American professional basketball player for the **Houston Rockets** (#7) of the NBA. Nicknamed **"the Slim Reaper"**, he is widely regarded as one of the greatest basketball players and one of the greatest scorers of all time.

### Personal Information
- **Born:** September 29, 1988, in Washington, D.C., U.S.
- **Height:** 6 ft 11 in (2.11 m)
- **Weight:** 240 lb (109 kg)
- **Position:** Small forward / Power forward
- **League:** NBA

### Education & Early Career
- Attended **Oak Hill Academy** (Virginia) and **Montrose Christian School** (Maryland)
- Played one season of college basketball for the **Texas Longhorns** (2006–2007), where he won numerous year-end awards and became the first freshman to be named **Naismith College Player of the Year**
- Named **National college player of the year** in 2007

### Professional Career
- Selected as the **2nd overall pick** by the **Seattle SuperSonics** in the **2007 NBA draft**
- Played nine seasons with the franchise (which became the Oklahoma City Thunder in 2008), leading them to a Finals appearance in 2012 and winning the MVP award for the 2013–14 season
- Signed with the **Golden State Warriors** in 2016, winning back-to-back **NBA Championships and Finals MVPs** in 2017 and 2018
- Joined the **Brooklyn Nets** in 2019 after an Achilles injury
- Traded to the **Phoenix Suns** in 2023
- Signed with the **Houston Rockets** in July 2025

### Career Highlights
- **2× NBA Champion** (2017, 2018)
- **2× NBA Finals MVP** (2017, 2018)
- **NBA MVP** (2014)
- **16× NBA All-Star** (2010–2019, 2021–2026)
- **2× NBA All-Star Game MVP** (2012, 2019)
- **6× All-NBA First Team** (2010–2014, 2018)
- **6× All-NBA Second Team** (2016, 2017, 2019, 2022, 2024, 2026)
- **NBA Rookie of the Year** (2008)
- **4× NBA scoring champion** (2010–2012, 2014)
- **NBA 75th Anniversary Team** (2021)
- **4× Olympic Gold Medalist** (2012, 2016, 2020, 2024) — the only male basketball player to win four Olympic gold medals
- Also won gold at the **2010 FIBA World Championship**
- Ranks **5th on the NBA career scoring leaders** list

*Source: Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kevin_Durant)*
